name: Deore XT direct-mount front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 147 g for the FD-M771-D direct-mount 3×9-speed front derailleur, including its mounting bolt. The exact model column identifies Direct Mount and the weight heading specifies direct type with bolt. Clamp-band and E-type alternatives do not inherit this weight.
